<!--
Title: <type>(<TASK-ID>): <description>, e.g. docs(INV-1234): add the onboarding guide.
How to write each section: HUB_Pull_Request_Description_Standard. The push
helpers and the CI check refuse a description without the TLDR line, the
Problem and This PR bullets, the four Handoff lines or a filled Evidence. No
agent attribution, no list of touched files, no personal checklist, no em or
en dash.
-->

## Task

<!-- Link to the Linear task. -->

## Summary

> TLDR: <!-- One sentence, present tense: what changes. -->

- Problem: <!-- What is wrong or missing today, and who feels it. Simple words. -->
- This PR: <!-- What this pull request changes to solve it. -->

<!-- Optional: a short paragraph for the why the two bullets cannot hold. -->

## Changes

| <!-- Axis: document, section, page --> | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| | |

<!-- What the table cannot hold: what was measured, what did not change, what is out of scope. -->

## Evidence

<!-- What was checked, how, and the result: the validators run and what they reported. -->

## Handoff

<!-- Always present. Write "none" where there is nothing to say. The full handoff record stays on the Linear task; Record links it. -->

Next:    <!-- what stays open and who picks it up -->
Ask:     <!-- the one action the reviewer takes -->
Blocker: <!-- what stops the work and who clears it -->
Record:  <!-- link to the Continue or Request comment on the task -->
